activeSlice.scope: Remove the unnecessary model invocation from the disposable Vercel Hunter shadow bootstrap while retaining verified public source ingestion, deterministic source-backed canonical readiness fields, the real measured V1 control model execution, substantive comparability, and every rollout/authority guard.
successCriteria: Disposable Vercel bootstrap fetches and persists verified public about/policy sources without invoking a model proposal generator.
The six canonical disposable Vercel readiness fields remain explicitly bound to the active about/policy source IDs.
Canonical Brand Brain activation must report Hunter-ready before the disposable context can enter the cohort.
The subsequent Hunter V1 control remains a real measured model execution and must satisfy substantive control comparability.
No synthetic readiness bypass or fabricated public evidence is introduced.
Three distinct Brands and nine paired observations remain mandatory for the pre-gate.
All rollout thresholds remain unchanged, including latency 1.5x, cost 1.5x, retrieval 0.85, failure 0.05, exploration 0.08-0.20, and maximum topic share 0.34.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
Corrected 3x3 pre-gate passes before any 30-pair full gate.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: Targeted screening removed prior 429 pressure, but the disposable Vercel bootstrap consumed a model invocation immediately before the V1 control; the control then failed substantive comparability before producing a candidate-pipeline event.
